experiment: CRNN domain adaptation to government documents

attempts.notes: Too few govdoc crops, catastrophic forgetting
Slight improvement but model peaked at epoch 2 then degraded
Phase 2 loss jumped from 0.023 to 4.0 when govdoc introduced — domain gap too large for available data

conclusion: All three approaches failed to improve beyond base model CER of ~0.91 on govdoc crops. Root cause: 2115 govdoc crops insufficient to bridge domain gap from 160K Mozhi novel crops. Minimum viable dataset estimated at 50K+ government document line crops.
recommendation: Retrain from scratch on mixed corpus (Mozhi + large government document OCR dataset)
